tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Discover the right TaleSpinner offering for any personalized story request, including bedtime and children's stories, gifts, memoirs, life stories, family histories, tributes, celebrations, classroom stories, illustrated books, and printed keepsakes.

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Help a new customer start using TaleSpinner for a personalized story request before connecting their account to the assistant.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Get the connected TaleSpinner account and current credit balances.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get credit balances and subscription status for the connected TaleSpinner account.

tools.name: list_stories
tools.description: List stories owned by the connected TaleSpinner account.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: Read a story owned by the connected TaleSpinner account.

tools.name: get_story_status
tools.description: Check whether a story's pages and illustrations are ready.

tools.name: rename_story
tools.description: Change the title of a story owned by the connected account.

tools.name: replace_story_page_text
tools.description: Replace the text on one story page. This also permanently clears that page's existing narration audio so it can be regenerated from the new text.

tools.name: delete_story
tools.description: Permanently delete a story owned by the connected account. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_story_share_links
tools.description: List active and revoked share links for a story owned by the connected account.

tools.name: create_story_share_link
tools.description: Create or return the active public share link for a story owned by the connected account.

tools.name: revoke_story_share_link
tools.description: Revoke one public story share link. Anyone using that link will immediately lose access.

tools.name: publish_story_to_world
tools.description: Publish a story owned by the connected account to the public Story World library.

tools.name: remove_story_from_world
tools.description: Remove a story owned by the connected account from the public Story World library. The story remains in the owner's private library.

tools.name: create_story
tools.description: Create a personalized story and spend the connected account's credits. Call only after the user explicitly approves the credit spend.

tools.name: list_life_projects
tools.description: List life-story and keepsake projects owned by the connected account.

tools.name: get_life_project
tools.description: Get a life-story project's details and latest generation status.

tools.name: create_life_project
tools.description: Create a memoir, family legacy, celebration, tribute, or life-series project.

tools.name: record_life_project_activity
tools.description: Update the last-activity time for a life-story project owned by the connected account.

tools.name: close_life_project_contributions
tools.description: Close a life-story project to new contributor submissions. Existing contributions remain available.

tools.name: delete_life_project
tools.description: Permanently delete a life-story project and its answers, contributors, generations, and project orders.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: List print orders belonging to the connected TaleSpinner account.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Create a secure handoff URL where the connected user can review and purchase a physical printed book in TaleSpinner.
